faqList.question: Is service pricing restricted to San Francisco only?
faqList.answer: Yes, all published menu rates are for appointments within San Francisco proper. A travel and logistics surcharge is added for out-of-town on-location styling throughout the greater San Francisco Bay Area.

faqList.question: What exactly is a concierge hair stylist?
faqList.answer: A concierge stylist brings professional, high-end salon expertise directly to you. April provides bespoke on-location hair styling, vintage updos, and cuts at your private home, hotel, commercial photo set, or event venue for ultimate convenience and zero travel stress.

faqList.question: What are vintage victory rolls and retro Hollywood waves?
faqList.answer: These are iconic, authentic mid-century hair styling techniques. Victory rolls are meticulously rolled, sculpted, and structurally set curls pinned high on the crown. S-waves (or classic Hollywood waves) are continuous, high-gloss, polished waves that create a continuous ribbon-like ripple down the hair, popular in 1940s and 50s fashion.
